_comment: The hosts a link to counts as a link to a paste site, for the install scanner's
paste_site_link rule (install_instructions.py). Text pasted there can change after the
review, and installers that hide behind one are a known trick, so a skill, README or
prerequisite linking to one is told to the owner. Data, not code: add or drop a host
here. A subdomain of a host counts as the host.
